title: Design System: Technology Enhanced Learning at VTC (SHAPE M2)
note: Regenerated 14 Sep 2026 to match the flat tangerine editorial system (DESIGN.md) after the card-kit rendition was rejected. Human-readable source of truth: DESIGN.md.

display.purpose: 800-weight page title, straight on the tangerine ground.

label.purpose: 800-weight route stop names, sentence case; underlined when active.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Fill and border responses on options and the submit button; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: route-state
motion.purpose: Route badge color transitions as stops change state; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: cue-pulse
motion.purpose: The cueing route badge pulses ink to burnt orange until the person does what it asks (watch → identify); reduced motion holds burnt orange instead.

motion.name: confetti-burst
motion.purpose: Fires once from the completion line when the seventh answer lands, in the page palette; skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Start-again Button
components.description: Quiet outline control that reloads the page for a fresh shuffle; tangerine fill on hover. Kept quieter than the verdict rows on purpose.
components.css: .ds-btn-reload { font: 800 1rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem; color: #2b1a0c; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-reload:hover { background: #ffd2a5; border-color: #a53a08; } .ds-btn-reload:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a53a08; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Row
components.description: Flat bordered paper field with a square letter marker; selecting reveals the verdict immediately — solid green (correct) or solid red (incorrect) with white text; deselect returns to rest. Nothing reveals before selection.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem; text-align: left; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2b1a0c; background: #fff8ee; border: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-option:hover { background: #ffd2a5; border-color: #a53a08; } .ds-option.is-correct { background: #22663a; border-color: #22663a; } .ds-option.is-incorrect { background: #a02c1e; border-color: #a02c1e; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a53a08; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-option-letter { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; color: #2b1a0c; background: #ffe3c2; border: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-option.is-correct .ds-option-letter, .ds-option.is-incorrect .ds-option-letter { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; } .ds-option.is-correct .ds-option-letter { color: #22663a; } .ds-option.is-incorrect .ds-option-letter { color: #a02c1e; } .ds-option-label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-option.is-correct .ds-option-label, .ds-option.is-incorrect .ds-option-label { color: #fff; }

components.name: Route Stop
components.description: Two stops only (Watch, Identify), each atop its own column — the label is that column's heading. Square ink numeral, 800-weight label; active is burnt orange with an underlined label, done is soft umber. No connector. The stop asking for action pulses its badge until the person acts (cue).
components.css: .ds-route-stop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-route-num { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; color: #ffd2a5; background: #2b1a0c; border-radius: 2px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-route-label { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.015em; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; } .ds-route-stop.is-active .ds-route-num { color: #fff; background: #a53a08; } .ds-route-stop.is-active .ds-route-label { color: #a53a08; border-bottom-color: #d9480f; } .ds-route-stop.is-done .ds-route-label { color: #6b4f34; } @keyframes ds-cue-pulse { 0%, 100% { background: #2b1a0c; color: #ffd2a5; } 50% { background: #a53a08; color: #fff; } } .ds-route-stop.is-cue .ds-route-num { animation: ds-cue-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-route-stop.is-cue .ds-route-num { animation: none; background: #a53a08; color: #fff; } }

components.name: Guide Panel
components.description: Sticky briefing column beside the activity: heading, three numbered steps in square markers, and the QR code as a bordered field. Separated by a 1.5px ink column rule, no card. Collapses to a disclosure above the video below 1201px and is hidden in expanded video mode.

components.css: .ds-guide { position: sticky; top: 1.5rem; padding-right: 1.5rem; border-right: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-guide-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; list-style: none; cursor: default; } .ds-guide-heading { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.015em; font-weight: 800; } .ds-guide-steps { list-style: none; margin: 1rem 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 1.1rem; } .ds-guide-steps li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.6rem; } .ds-guide-num { width: 1.4rem; height: 1.4rem; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; color: #ffd2a5; background: #2b1a0c; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-guide-label { margin: 0 0 0.15rem; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-guide-qr { display: block; width: 8.5rem; height: auto; margin-top: 0.7rem; border: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Expand Control
components.description: Small outline toggle at the right of the Watch header; expands the player across the full content width and pins it while the answers scroll beneath. Layout-only change, so playback never restarts; expanded state tints tangerine.
components.css: .ds-btn-expand { margin-left: auto; font: 700 0.85rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; color: #2b1a0c; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #2b1a0c; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-expand:hover, .ds-btn-expand[aria-expanded='true'] { background: #ffd2a5; border-color: #a53a08; } .ds-btn-expand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a53a08; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: 800-weight title straight on the tangerine ground, closed by a 6px true-orange rule — no band, no card.
components.html:
Technology Enhanced Learning at VTC

VTC CLT Training and Workshop — an interactive video activity for SHAPE Module M2
components.css: .ds-masthead { padding: 2.4rem 0 1.7rem; border-bottom: 6px solid #d9480f; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2b1a0c; } .ds-masthead-inner { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-masthead h1 { margin: 0.3rem 0 0.45rem; font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-weight: 800; } .ds-mast-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #6b4f34; }

narrative.overview: The page IS light orange: one saturated tangerine field carries everything, and warm near-black typography does the structural work — flat as a departmental poster pinned to the wall. No cards float, nothing casts a shadow, no element is rounded into softness. Authority comes from weight (800-weight display), strong 1.5px ink borders, and one bold color gesture: the verdict reveal on a selected answer.
keyCharacteristics: A saturated tangerine ground (#ffe3c2) covers the entire page; content sits directly on it.
One family (system sans), weight-driven hierarchy up to 800.
Flat editorial geometry: square 2px markers, 4px fields, a 6px orange masthead rule.
Zero elevation — no shadows anywhere; borders and fills do all separation.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: No shadows, ever. Separation is borders (1.5px ink), fills, and spacing. If an element seems to need a shadow, it needs a border instead.

rules.name: The Verdict Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only as the live reveal on a selected answer (correct = solid green, incorrect = solid red). Everything else on the surface stays orange/ink.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every element is the system sans. Serif faces, italics, uppercase tracked labels, and second families are out of world.

dos: Do let the tangerine ground own the page — content sits on the color, not on white cards.
Do keep everything flat: borders and fill steps, never shadows.
Do keep the revealed row as the boldest element on the page.
Do keep route states live (cue pulse, active underline, done umber).
donts: Don't reintroduce the generated-card kit: white rounded cards, soft shadows, pill chips, or circular badges.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels, gradient text, or side-stripe borders.
Don't lighten the ground toward cream (#faf3e9 territory) — the drench is the identity.
Don't add a second type family or serif display.
